s: Yisrael venokri ek yitnahagu beshuttaput ubo y"t seipim: yisrael venokri sheqqibbelu sadeh beshuttaput sheyyihyeh muttal al shenehem laamol lacharosh velizroa ushear kol abodot hassadeh ukesheyyaggia haqqatzir yittelu cheleq bapperot bead abodatam — lo yomar hayyisrael lehannokri "abod atta beshabbat ukesheyyaggia haqqatzir tittol chelqeka bapperot keneged abodateka gam beshabbatot, vaani eebod keneged zeh yom echad bechol veettol chelqi bapperot keneged abodati bechol". Ap al pi shehannokri mitkavven baabodato beshabbat letobat atzmo, umuttar lomar lenokri "aseh melaka beshabbat letzorkeka" kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"z, mikkol maqom kevan sheabodat hassadeh muttelet bekol yom veyom al shenehem beshaveh chatzi yom al zeh vachatzi yom al zeh, im ken keshehayyisrael omer lehannokri sheyyaabod beshabbat kol hayyom vehu yaabod keneged zeh yom echad shalem bechol — hare zeh kemaamid poel bimqomo sheyyaaseh melakto beshabbat:

Vaapillu im lo amar lehannokri kelum, ella hannokri meatzmo haya obed kol yeme hashshabbatot vehayyisrael haya obed kenegdan bechol (bistam, shello peresh sheoseh ken liproa lehannokri shehitasseq bishbilo beshabbat) — asur lehayyisrael sheyyabo lecheshbon im hannokri bishat chaluqqat happerot velomar nachaloq beshaveh, shekkol yom hashshabbat sheabadta abadti kenegdo bechol, lepi shebbezeh hu megalleh dato shezzeh sheabad yom shalem bechol abad chetzyo bishbil hannokri kede liproa lehannokri sheabad bishbilo chatzi yom hashshabbat, venimtza abodat chatzi yom hashshabbat necheshebet al shemo, vahare zeh notel sekar shabbat shello behablaa, shehare mazkir et yom hashshabbat beperush, ella yanniach lehannokri shemma yirtzeh yittol leatzmo techilla keneged kol hashshabbatot sheabad hu lebaddo vehashshear yachaloq immo beshaveh. Veim nitratztza hannokri meelayv lachaloq immo beshaveh belo sheyyachshob immo hayyisrael yom hachol keneged yom hashshabbat, o apillu natal hannokri chelqo gam bead hashshabbatot sheabad vehinniach lehayyisrael chelqo gam bead yemot hachol sheabad lebaddo, ella sheasa ken meelayv belo sheyyachshob immo hayyisrael — yesh mattirin, dekevan shello gilla hayyisrael atzmo dato beperush sheyyesh lo cheleq baabodat hannokri beshabbatot — en kan sekar shabbat kelal. Veyesh oserin bishnehem, mittaam sheyyitbaer. Veken iqqar. Umikkol maqom, bimqom hepsed gadol yesh lismok al dibre hammattirin:

Veim mittechilla beshaa sheqqibbelu hassadeh hitna hayyisrael im hannokri shebbeyom hashshabbat lo yihyeh muttal kelal al hayyisrael laabod bassadeh raq al hannokri lebaddo, ubeyom echad bechol yihyeh muttal al hayyisrael lebaddo — hare zeh muttar, dekevan shehitna immo beshaa sheqqibbel alayv abodat hassadeh shello yihyeh muttal alayv kelal beshabbat — nimtza shebbeshabbat en lehayyisrael cheleq bassadeh kelal, ella kullah muttelet al hannokri lebaddo beshabbat, veen hannokri oseh kelal bead hayyisrael, vekullah muttelet al hayyisrael lebaddo beyom echad bechol. Ulepikak, muttar lo achar kak labo immo becheshbon lachshob yeme hachol sheabad hu lebaddo keneged shabbatot sheabad hannokri lebaddo velachaloq happerot beshaveh, veen zeh notel sekar shabbat ella sekar yeme hachol:

Yisrael venokri shehayu shuttapin bimlaka o bischora bachanut, im hitnu mittechilla beshaa shennishtattepu sheyyehe sekar yom hashshabbat lenokri bilbaddo hen rab hen meat, usekar yom echad achar hashshabbat kenegdo leyisrael bilbaddo — hare zeh muttar, mittaam shennitbaer. Vaapillu im achar kak nitratztza hannokri lachaloq immo kol hassakar beshaveh — en bekak kelum, shemmattana hu shennoten lo. Abal im bau lecheshbon achar kak, sheamar hannokri leyisrael "atta natalta bilbaddeka bechol maneh vaani natalti beshabbat tz' zuz, malle li ad sheyyihyeh lanu chalaqim shavim", vekol shekken im amar ken hayyisrael lehannokri, shennimtza hattenay shehitnu battechilla sheyyehe sekar hashshabbat lehannokri bilbaddo hen rab hen meat lo haya ella haarama bealma, ella hannokri hitasseq beshabbat gam bead hayyisrael, ubishbil zeh hitasseq hayyisrael bechol gam bead hannokri, lekak hem choleqim achar kak beshaveh, venimtza sheggam hayyisrael notel sekar shabbat, venotelo shello behablaa, shehare mazkir lo et yom hashshabbat beperush, lepikak tzarik sheyyanniach lehannokri sheyyittol leatzmo im yirtzeh sekar kol hashshabbatot, veachar kak yachaloq immo beshaveh:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehaya sekar hashshabbat yadua, abal im eno yadua — yakol lachaloq immo kol hassakar beshaveh, kevan shehitna immo sheyyehe sekar yom echad lo lebaddo keneged sekar yom hashshabbat sheyyittol hannokri lebaddo, umin hassetam sekar yom echad shaveh lachabero, lepikak choleqin kol hassakar beshaveh:

Veim lo hitnu battechilla beshaa shennishtattepu, vegam achar shennishtattepu lo amar hayyisrael lehannokri sheyyitasseq beshabbat vehu yitasseq keneged zeh yom echad bechol, ella hannokri meatzmo hitasseq beshabbat, vehayyisrael bilbaddo hitasseq yom echad bechol (setam, shello peresh shemmitasseq bilbaddo baabur shehannokri hitasseq bilbaddo beshabbat), im achar kak nitratztza hannokri lachaloq immo kol hassakar beshaveh meelayv belo sheyyachashob immo hayyisrael, vegam hannokri lo hizkir lo hashshabbatot kelal ella chalaq immo setam — yesh mattirin, shehare en kan issur mishshum sekar shabbat, kevan shennotelo behablaa im shear hayyamim. Veyesh oserim, ella yanniach lehannokri sekar kol hashshabbatot, veim en sekar hashshabbatot yadua — yanniach lo shebiit hassakar vehashshear yachaloq immo beshaveh, sheim yachaloq immo kol hassakar beshaveh veyehaneh hayyisrael missekar shabbat — nimtza shellemaprea haya lehayyisrael cheleq baabodat hannokri beshabbatot, vehaya hannokri obed bishbilo keillu haya shelucho. Veken iqqar. Im lo behepsed gadol, sheaz yesh lismok al sebara harishona, kemo shennitbaer:

Abal im hayu shuttapin bedabar sheen tzarik laasot bo shum melaka, kegon shehayu shuttapin betannur shekkol mi shemmassiq hattannur veopeh bo noten lahem sakar, veen muttal alehem kelal eseq hesseq hattannur raq eseq qabbalat hassakar muttal al shenehem beshaveh, ap al pi shello hitnu battechilla beshaa shennishtattepu sheyyehe eseq qabbalat hassakar muttal al hannokri lebaddo sheyyeqabbel leatzmo sekar hashshabbat hen rab hen meat usekar yom echad lehayyisrael lebaddo, im achar kak lo amar lehannokri sheyyitasseq lebaddo leqabbel sekar hashshabbat vesheyyitasseq hu lebaddo leqabbel sekar yom acher, ella hannokri meatzmo hitasseq lebaddo leqabbel sekar hashshabbat vehayyisrael lebaddo hitasseq beyom acher, veachar kak bishat chaluqqa nitratztza hannokri meelayv lachaloq kol hassakar beshaveh — hare zeh muttar ledibre hakkol, shekkan en lomar mishshum shennimtza shellemaprea haya lehayyisrael cheleq baabodat hannokri beshabbatot vehaya hannokri obed bishbilo, shehare kan lo abad hannokri kelum, raq sheqqibbel sekar hashshabbat, vesakar zeh notelo mimmennu hayyisrael behablaa shebbishar hayyamim:

Vaapillu im hem shuttapin bedabar shetztzarik laasot bo melaka, im en hayyisrael oseh bechol keneged mah shehannokri oseh beshabbat, ella kol yemot hachol hem mitasseqim beshaveh shenehem beyachad, o zeh chatzi yom vezeh chatzi yom, o zeh yom vezeh yom, lebad miyyom hashshabbat shehannokri mitasseq bo lebaddo — azay muttar lehayyisrael lachaloq immo kol hassakar beshaveh ledibre hakkol, dekevan sheen hayyisrael porea lehannokri kelum bead abodato beshabbat, shehare eno obed keneged zeh bechol kelum, im ken mah sheobed hannokri beshabbat lebaddo hu mitkavven letobat atzmo bilbad kede lehistakker, veeno kishlucho shel hayyisrael, sheeno oseh bishbilo kelal. Veap sheachar kak maggia lehayyisrael hanaa mizzeh shecholeq immo beshaveh — en bekak kelum, kevan shehannokri lo nitkavven lahanaat hayyisrael ella letobat atzmo. Umikkol maqom, yizzaher shello lachaloq sekar hashshabbat ella behablaa im shear hayyamim, ap al pi shemmeiqqar haddin en kan issur mishshum sekar shabbat, shehare en lehayyisrael cheleq kelal bimleket hannokri beshabbat umah shecholeq immo beshaveh mattana hu shennoten lo, mikkol maqom yesh leesor, lepi shennireh haddabar keillu hu notel sekar shabbat, kevan sheyyesh lo cheleq beoto dabar shehannokri oseh bo hammelaka beshabbat:

Veken yisrael sheyyesh lo tannur shekkullo shello venoteno lenokri sheyyassiqennu veyopeh lekol mi sheyyirtzeh leepot, veyachaloq immo hassakar beshaveh midde yom beyom — yakol lachaloq immo ap sekar hashshabbatot behablaa, lepi shehannokri mitkavven baabodato beshabbat letobat atzmo, veeno kishlucho shel hayyisrael, kevan sheen hammelaka muttelet kelal al hayyisrael raq al hannokri lebaddo, vegam en hayyisrael metzavveh lo sheyyaaseh beshabbat, ella meatzmo hu oseh lahanaat atzmo vehayyisrael neheneh meelayv. Umikkol maqom, lo yannichennu lekattechilla lehitasseq betannuro beshabbat ella bimqomot shemmuttarim sham lehaskir tannur lenokrim vehannokrim mitasseqim battannur ap beshabbatot, veen chosheshin sham lemarit haayin, mittaam shennitbaer besimman rm"g. Abal bimqomot acherim asur lekattechilla mippene marit haayin, kemo shennitbaer sham leinyan sekirut:

Veken haddin bemerchatz verechayim vachanut. Im en hayyisrael choleq im hannokri sekar kol hayyamim beshaveh, ella kol hassakar shel yom echad lehayyisrael hen rab hen meat, vekol hassakar shel yom b' lehannokri hen rab hen meat — asur lo littol sekar yom echad keneged sekar yom hashshabbat shennatal hannokri leatzmo, sheim yittol kol hassakar shel yom echad bechol keneged yom hashshabbat — nimtza shettarach hannokri lehitasseq battannur beoto hayyom shel chol bead sekar yom hashshabbat shennatal kullo leatzmo, vahare neheneh hayyisrael mittorach zeh shehu sekar shabbat shello behablaa:

Vaapillu hitna immo ken mittechilla qodem shennishtattep immo biskar hattannur — en zeh moil kelum, sheen hattenay moil ella kesheyyesh lehannokri cheleq begup haddabar sheoseh bo hammelaka, sheaz keshemmatneh immo mittechilla sheyyehe sekar hashshabbat lehannokri lebaddo usekar yom echad lehayyisrael lebaddo — hare zeh kemaqneh lo chelqo sheyyesh lo begup oto dabar, sheyyehe kol gup oto dabar qanuy lehannokri lebaddo kol yeme hashshabbatot ubeyom echad kenegdan lehayyisrael lebaddo, abal kan shekkol gup hattannur hu shel hayyisrael, ap shehitna immo sheyyehe hattannur beshabbat lehannokri lebaddo, mikkol maqom lo hiqnahu lo qinyan gamur lachalutin lekol hashshabbatot ap im lo yitasseq battannur kenegdan bechol bishbil sekar hayyisrael, ella hiqnahu al tenay al menat sheyyitasseq bechol keneged hashshabbat, vahare zeh kemaskiro lo leshabbatot bead sheyyaasoq bishbilo bechol, vahare hu notel sekar shabbat shello behablaa:

Abal muttar lo lehatnot im hannokri (mittechilla) sheyyittol leatzmo sekar b' o g' yamim ukeneged zeh yitten lehayyisrael sekar b' o g' yamim acherim, ap al pi shehashshabbat hu beotan hayyamim shennotel hannokri ukenegdo notel hayyisrael — en bezeh issur mishshum sekar shabbat, kevan shennotelo behablaa im yom acher. Umikkol maqom, en tenay zeh moil ella keshehiqna lo cheleq begup hattannur, dehaynu shebbeyamim ellu shehashshabbat betokam gup hattannur hu qanuy lehannokri, shennimtza hu oseh melaka battannur shello, veeno nireh kishlucho shel yisrael. Abal im lo hiqna lo cheleq begup hattannur — asur lomar lo sheyyittol lo sekar yamim ellu shehashshabbat betokam bead sheyyassiq lo bechol, dekevan shemmassiq beshabbat betannuro shel yisrael veyesh revach leyisrael behesseq hashshabbat, sheim lo haya massiq beshabbat leatzmo lo haya massiq leyisrael bechol — hare nireh keillu massiq beshabbat bishbil hayyisrael ubishlichuto shetztzivvahu laasoq beshabbat:

Apillu im hammelaka muttelet gam al hayyisrael, kegon shehem shuttapim betannur o bemerchatz o berechayim o bimlaka o bischora bachanut — en issur keshello hitnu mittechilla, ella keshehu obed lebaddo beyom echad bechol keneged hashshabbat sheabad hannokri lebaddo venotel kol sekar yom hahu leatzmo, abal im kol yemot hachol hem shavim baaboda ubesakar yakol lehaskir kol hashshabbatavat lannokri behablaa, sheyyaabod lebaddo b' o g' yamim veyittol kol hassakar leatzmo hen rab hen meat, raq sheyyitten lehayyisrael dabar qatzub bead b' o g' yamim ellu, ap al pi shehashshabbat biklalam — en bekak kelum, kevan sheeno metzavveh lo sheyyaaseh beshabbat, vehannokri oseh meatzmo letobato. Veap bimqomot sheasurim sham lehaskir lenokri tannur merchatz verechayim mippene marit haayin, mikkol maqom kan kevan shehannokri shuttap immo — en kan marit haayin, shehakkol yodein sheyyesh lehannokri cheleq bimlaka zo velahanaat atzmo hu mitkavven. Umittaam zeh, bekol maqom shehittiru beshuttaput nokri — hittiru apillu oseh beparhesya, veen chosheshin lemarit haayin:

Veken yakol liskor et hannokri shuttapo beqabbelanut, dehaynu sheyyaabod hannokri gam bead cheleq hayyisrael, ubead kak vekak sakar sheyyistakker lechelqo yitten lo kak vekak, raq shello yomar lo sheyyaaseh beshabbat, ella yomar lo kol emat shettistakker lechelqi kak vekak etten leka kak vekak, vehannokri oseh leatzmo apillu beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"d, sheen bezeh issur ella mishshum marit haayin, vekan shehannokri hu shuttapo — en kan chashash marit haayin:

Kol maqom shemmoil im hitnu, im lo hitnu battechilla beshaa shennishtattepu — yesh tiqqun al yede sheyyebattelu hashshittup veyimchalu zeh lezeh hattenaim shebbenehem veyachzeru lehishtattep veyatnu beet hashshittup. Veim nishtattepu bachanut velo hitnu battechilla — yachzeru veyiqchu kol echad chelqo vibattelu hashshuttaput, veachar kak yachzeru lehishtattep veyatnu battechilla. Veim laqechu sadeh beshuttaput velo hitnu battechilla — yebaqshu mehammoker sheyyachazor lahem demehem, veachar kak yachzeru veyiqnu mimmennu qinyan chadash veyatnu beet haqqeniyya. (Veayyen bechoshen mishpat simman qtz"d din qeniyyat hannokri, veayyen sham simman qp"t):

Muttar litten lenokri sechora lemokrah o maot lehitasseq bahen, veap shehannokri mitasseq bahen beshabbat — en bekak kelum, kevan shehayyisrael lo tzivva lo sheyyitasseq beshabbat. Ubilbad sheyyiqtzotz lo sakar bead torcho, o sheyyitten lo cheleq meharevach sheyyarviach, sheaz hu mitkavven beosqo beshabbat letobat atzmo leharbot biskaro, vehayyisrael neheneh meelayv keshennotel gam sekar shabbat behablaa. Veen leesor mippene marit haayin shello yomru shehu shelucho shel hayyisrael, lepi sheen hakkol yodein shemmaot ellu usechora zo hen shel yisrael:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen hammelaka muttelet kelal al hayyisrael raq al hannokri lebaddo, sheaz en hannokri kishlucho laasot melaka beshabbat, kevan sheenah muttelet kelal al hayyisrael, o apillu im hi muttelet gam ken alayv, ella sheeno oseh lebaddo yom echad keneged yom hashshabbat sheasa hannokri lebaddo, shekkevan sheen hayyisrael porea kelum lehannokri bead abodato beshabbat lebaddah — en hannokri mitkavven kelal baabodato beshabbat raq bishbil atzmo velo bishbil hayyisrael, veeno kishlucho. Abal im hu oseh lebaddo yom echad keneged yom hashshabbat sheasa hannokri lebaddo — hare hannokri kishlucho. Veen taqqana lezeh ella shello yehaneh kelum mimmaaseh hannokri beshabbat, dehaynu shekkol hassakar shel hashshabbat yanniach lehannokri lebaddo, ella im ken hu hepsed gadol, sheaz yesh lismok al daat hammattirin lehanot missekar shabbat behablaa al derek shennitbaer:

Yisrael shellaqach tannur lemashkon, veqibbel alayv hannokri shemmah sheyyaaleh sekar hattannur yitten kullo lehayyisrael beribbit meotayv — muttar leqabbel mimmennu gam sekar hashshabbat apillu shello behablaa, lepi sheggup hattannur hu shel hannokri, veen lehayyisrael cheleq bo kelal, vegam en hayyisrael omer lo sheyyaaseh beshabbat, ella hannokri meatzmo hu oseh letobato, kede leshallem chobo shennitchayyeb litten sekar hattannur lehayyisrael beribbit meotayv:
Im apu nokrim beshabbat betannuro shel yisrael beal korcho venatenu lo sekar hattannur — asur lehanot mimmennu olamit, ben lo ben laacherim, mippene shehu sekar shabbat:
